mentions.name: Personal habit tracker
mentions.description: A personal habit tracker built as a single HTML file with data saved by vanilla JS in the browser's local storage. The author plans to add a few more features, then re-implement the finished tracker in React, Svelte, Vue, Preact and other frameworks, both to get familiar with those frameworks and to practice using AI (Cursor) as a personal tutor.
mentions.problem: Previous attempts to learn frameworks like React and Laravel by building fresh projects from scratch got stuck early due to lack of knowledge and understanding; re-implementing something already understood is meant to make learning more effective.
mentions.audience: The author, for personal use only
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a personal habit tracker, solely for my own use. It is intended to be pretty basic - just a html file, with data saved by vanilla JS in browser's local storage.
